screened: Every config is actually run for 90 frames on the export pipeline: canvas not blank, frames 5≠30 moving; of configs whose pictures are identical only one is kept; then a byte-by-byte comparison of "fresh vs reuse" is done via the URL route (for recommended ones also "vs static skip"), and mismatches are removed, see excluded
usage: add_clip cardId "particles", params.config = url (simple parameters have no effect then), seed changes the layout

items.name: basic
items.description: Classic: floating dots with connecting lines
items.note: Many tiny red-orange particles wander over a dark background, and nearby particles weave a network of gray connecting lines.
items.use: Suited to digital-network concepts, cutting-edge tech showcases or dynamic UI background patterns.

items.name: big
items.description: Large translucent discs covering the whole frame
items.note: Large translucent blobs in red, green, blue, yellow and other colors overlap one another and drift slowly across the frame.
items.use: Suited to lively, bright short films, music rhythm or dreamy aesthetic backgrounds.

items.name: bigBlend
items.note: Large translucent colored blobs overlap and blend into bright colors, slowly drifting over time and changing position and stacked colors.
items.use: Suited to dreamy light-spot backgrounds, aesthetic MVs or event opening atmospheres.

items.name: bubble
items.note: Faint translucent hexagonal dark patches are scattered on a dark background and slowly drift to new positions over time.
items.use: Suited to minimalist dark-toned intros, low-contrast dark backgrounds or background patterns.

items.name: colorAnimation
items.description: Particles whose color cycles through changes
items.note: Scattered dot particles drift while their overall color gradually shifts from pure blue to magenta and pink.
items.use: Suited to trendy fashion shorts, music rhythm or energetic transition backgrounds.

items.name: fallingConfetti
items.note: Colored round and polygonal paper-scrap particles of varying sizes keep rotating and falling across a dark frame.
items.use: Accent for gala celebrations, game-clear victories or holiday carnival videos.

items.name: gradients
items.note: Dense pure-white round light-spot particles of varying sizes keep floating and drifting gently on a dark background.
items.use: Accent for aesthetic romance, a sky full of snowflakes or an ethereal dreamy atmosphere.

items.name: groups
items.description: Several groups of particles in different sizes and colors
items.note: Small translucent gray-white round particles are scattered across the whole screen and flow by translating evenly and slowly over time.
items.use: Minimalist understated underlay, floating dust or light atmospheric backgrounds.

items.name: lch
items.description: Particles with a gradient in the LCH color space
items.note: Very faint tiny white nodes and triangular mesh links move and deform slowly on a dark background.
items.use: Abstract geometry, network topology or dark tech-UI intros.

items.name: life
items.description: Particles that are constantly born and die
items.note: Starting from a fully black first frame, dark-red particles emerge frame by frame and link into many long light-colored lines that criss-cross.
items.use: System boot, data-stream generation or network-building transitions.

items.name: linkTriangles
items.description: Links filled in as a triangle mesh
items.note: Translucent gray-white triangular facets connect red vertices, deforming and drifting on a dark background.
items.use: Suited to tech-style mesh backgrounds, polygon animations or data visualization.

items.name: nasa
items.description: Starry sky of fine star dots
items.note: Extremely tiny dim-white fine dots float and move slowly with slight amplitude on a deep black background.
items.use: Suited to deep starry skies, space exploration or immersive slow-paced backgrounds.

items.name: orbit
items.note: Small colored round and square dots in yellow, blue, green and orange keep revolving along curved orbits.
items.use: Suited to creative animation, tech showcases or light, dynamic video background patterns.

items.name: parallax
items.note: A linked network of gray-white particles of varying brightness and size drifts slowly in multiple parallax layers.
items.use: Suited to high-end business, AI or cutting-edge tech promo videos.

items.name: plasma
items.note: Extremely faint deep-blue thin line segments wander, wriggle and bend weakly on a dark background.
items.use: Suited to mysterious dark tones, plasma pulses or hidden electrical-signal displays.

items.name: poisson
items.note: Evenly distributed bright white nodes and a network of thin lines roam and regroup across the frame.
items.use: Suited to IoT, big-data transmission, blockchain or neural-network displays.

items.name: random
items.note: Colored round particles are densely scattered across the whole screen, each one continuously translating and floating freely in a different direction.
items.use: Suited as a dynamic background atmosphere for lively, cheerful or creative short videos.

items.name: repulse
items.note: Many bright-red dot particles are scattered across the whole screen, with faint links between neighboring dots, and they slowly disperse and drift.
items.use: Suited as a background accent for tech warnings, suspense or fiery dynamic videos.

items.name: slow
items.note: Sparse tiny white particles are joined by thin lines into a net, drifting extremely slowly on a dark background.
items.use: Suited as the underlay for tech-feel openings, academic presentations or calm narrative videos.

items.name: snow
items.note: White round light dots of varying sizes keep falling slowly and vertically from the top of the frame to the bottom.
items.use: Suited as a video overlay for winter snow scenes, holiday celebrations or a romantic, soothing atmosphere.

items.name: spin
items.note: Orange-red dot particles gather in the middle area, slowly rotating, swirling and spreading out around the center over time.
items.use: Suited to effects for intro spotlight spins, spark vortexes or energy-gathering scenes.

items.name: star
items.note: A few bright white light dots are joined by straight lines into polygonal constellations, with each vertex slowly translating and deforming.
items.use: Suited to astronomy explainers, stargazing night talks or video transitions in a minimalist geometric style.

items.name: strokeAnimation
items.note: Fine mesh-like particles and links gradually shift from blue-purple to bright pink and wander slowly on a dark background.
items.use: Suited as a dynamic base color for dreamy neon, cyberpunk or fashion-show videos.

items.name: triangles
items.note: Small solid equilateral triangles in red and green are scattered across the frame, each translating and floating in a different direction.
items.use: Suited to stock-market and financial broadcasts, game commentary or geometric-design-style video backgrounds.

items.name: twinkle
items.note: Dark-red specks and faint links flicker in and out of view all over the frame, alternately brightening and dimming while moving slowly.
items.use: Suited as an immersive background for videos with a mysterious dark mood, faint-glow night scenes or meditation and hypnosis.

items.name: vibrate
items.note: A network of tiny gray-white particles jitters and trembles in place at high frequency with small amplitude, while the overall position stays basically fixed.
items.use: Suited to the visual atmosphere of tense suspense, electronic signal interference or neuron pulses.

items.name: backgroundCanvas
items.note: Sparse faint white particles drift slowly on a dark-gray background, dynamically forming and breaking thin links according to the distance between them.
items.use: Suited to minimalist tech backgrounds, business presentations or data-visualization background patterns.

items.name: bigBlendCombo
items.note: Large red, green and blue discs drift and overlap, and where they intersect there is dark-toned fusion and light-dark variation.
items.use: Suited to avant-garde art shorts, color experiments or abstract stage backgrounds.

items.name: clickPause
items.note: Fine white particles and slender links drift slowly on a dark background, and the links keep regrouping and waxing and waning with distance.
items.use: Suited to tech-company promotion, data networks and science-explainer backgrounds.

items.name: collisionsAbsorb
items.note: White round particles of varying sizes drift and shuttle freely on a dark-gray background, with positions and spacing changing constantly.
items.use: Suited to microscopic particle simulation, simple tech base images or dot-matrix decoration.

items.name: collisionsBounce
items.note: Small white dot particles of uniform size drift and roam in straight lines at constant speed in all directions on a dark-gray background.
items.use: Suited to starry-sky accents, physics particle demos or dynamic decorative backgrounds.

items.name: delay
items.note: Faint orange-red specks and thin lines wander slowly on a dark background, dynamically forming a scattered network topology.
items.use: Suited to neural-network visualization, a gloomy tech feel or data-stream backgrounds.

items.name: delayColor
items.note: Red specks and mesh-like thin lines drift slowly, and some specks gradually turn from red to orange-yellow over time.
items.use: Tech-feel digital network backgrounds or data-flow transitions.

items.name: delayOpacity
items.note: Many white dot particles drift slowly, and the opacity of some gradually decreases and fades over time.
items.use: Starry-sky glimmer accents, night-scene atmosphere or text background patterns.

items.name: delaySize
items.note: Scattered white dot particles drift slightly, and the size of some gradually shrinks and thins over time.
items.use: Floating-dust effects, serene moods or abstract tech backgrounds.

items.name: delayStrokeColor
items.note: Tiny dark-red geometric wireframe particles drift, and the stroke color of some gradually turns orange-yellow over time.
items.use: Sci-fi UI screens, HUD motion graphics or minimalist graphic backgrounds.

items.name: destroy
items.note: Gray-white specks and thin polylines drift slowly, and the specks and links gradually fade away and thin out over time.
items.use: Data-dissipation effects, fading memories or end-of-film curtain-fall transitions.

items.name: destroyExplode
items.note: Colored dot particles are scattered and drifting, and some gradually disperse while moving, then vanish and thin out.
items.use: Holiday celebration confetti, cheerful beat-synced edits or party-atmosphere backgrounds.

items.name: effectBubble
items.note: Dark-red and orange round and square particles float upward, brightening in color and overlapping translucently.
items.use: Rising liquid bubbles, dreamy out-of-focus light spots or warm backgrounds.

items.name: effectFilter
items.note: Solid red dots float and drift upward, and the particle color gradually shifts as a whole to bright orange over time.
items.use: Energetic dynamic intros, energy-rise effects or fashion promo videos.

items.name: effectParticles
items.note: Yellow five-pointed-star particles rise and drift upward as a whole, gathering at the top edge of the frame at frames 5 and 6.
items.use: Dreams taking off, reward settlement or celebratory rising-atmosphere scenes.

items.name: effectTrailTransform
items.note: A dot matrix of fine particles drifts while its overall color cycles gradually through red, green, cyan, blue, magenta and yellow.
items.use: Dynamic beat-synced edits, dazzling-color transitions or neon-stage atmosphere backgrounds.

items.name: grabRandomColor
items.note: Sparse tiny dark-red particles wander slowly, and nearby particles occasionally form faint thin lines connecting them.
items.use: Minimalist tech, deep-space star charts or microscopic biological link backgrounds.

items.name: lightHover
items.note: Red-orange round and square particles gradually converge from all sides toward the center into a cluster.
items.use: Suited to tech-feel focus effects, core energy convergence or intro transitions.

items.name: mouseAttract
items.note: Very faint tiny dark-red dots and extremely light links are scattered on a dark background, floating and shifting slowly.
items.use: Suited to minimalist, understated tech intros or a dark-night starry-sky atmosphere underlay.

items.name: mouseDestroy
items.note: Fine round dot particles in red, yellow, cyan and other colors are scattered on a dark background, translating and floating slowly.
items.use: Suited to celebration parties, relaxed lively short videos or dreamy confetti backgrounds.

items.name: mouseDrag
items.note: A dense swarm of bright orange-red round particles keeps drifting and floating toward the upper right on a black background.
items.use: Suited to energy flow, fiery event promotion or dynamic rhythmic video backgrounds.

items.name: mouseParticle2
items.note: Faint red dots are connected by extremely thin gray-white lines into a polygonal network that keeps deforming and drifting.
items.use: Suited to network topology, blockchain displays or minimalist constellation tech-feel backgrounds.

items.name: moveAngle
items.note: Extremely sparse faint red dots and occasional thin lines glide slowly at constant speed along a fixed diagonal direction.
items.use: Suited to deep-space exploration, minimalist immersive storytelling or dark-night suspense background patterns.

items.name: moveDistance
items.note: Tiny red dots disperse and drift slowly against an extremely dark background, occasionally joined by extremely light thin lines.
items.use: Suited to extremely dark sci-fi backgrounds, microscopic particle displays or low-distraction video background patterns.

items.name: moveInside
items.note: Small red dot particles gradually gather and converge from the edges all around the frame toward the center area.
items.use: Suited to attention-focusing, energy-gathering or subject-entrance effects.

items.name: moveOutside
items.note: A dense swarm of red particles at the center keeps diverging, expanding and drifting outward in all directions.
items.use: Suited to energy bursts, shockwave spreading or intro-opening motion graphics.

items.name: noClear
items.description: Smear trails without clearing the screen
items.note: Densely packed multicolored star shapes keep overlapping and stacking, gradually filling the canvas.
items.use: Suited to festive carnivals, children's fun or lively, cheerful scene transitions.

excluded.reason: canvas shadow (shadowBlur) rasterizes inconsistently across the two passes, 60/60 frames differ

excluded.name: nyancat2
excluded.reason: Rainbow trail is inconsistent across the two passes, 32 frames differ

excluded.name: textMask
excluded.reason: canvas text mask is inconsistent across the two passes, 48 frames differ
